architecture_summary: Project-owned single-stage, one-class, anchor-free detector with stride 8/16/32 features, FPN/PAN-style fusion, decoupled objectness/regression heads, focal-style objectness loss, GIoU regression, dynamic assignment, and non-maximum suppression.
intended_use: Plate-region proposal generation within the reviewed ANPR Engine pipeline.
limitations: Development-validation metrics are not production accuracy.
project_provenance: Independently implemented and project-trained in PyTorch from random initialization; informed by established detection concepts.
